subject: INLA Stable version versus INLA Testing version

messages.author: 8c4163f5c1f749e2
messages.subject: INLA Stable version versus INLA Testing version
parts:
I have installed the stable version of INLA in R-Studio, but now I need the testing version to run a Negative Binomial Model.

It there any problem if I install the testing version of INLA, although I have the stable one?

Thank you all,
Sílvia

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA Stable version versus INLA Testing version
parts:
On Mon, 2018-10-29 at 05:51 -0700, Silvia Isabel wrote:
>
> I have installed the stable version of INLA in R-Studio, but now I
> need the testing version to run a Negative Binomial Model.
>
> It there any problem if I install the testing version of INLA,
> although I have the stable one?

you can only have one of them at the time.

if you have installed the testing one, then

inla.update(testing=FALSE)

should give the last stable one.
